newsitem.title: USA: Checkers to acquire Rally's Hamburgers.
newsitem.headline: Checkers to acquire Rally's Hamburgers.

text.p: Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc. has agreed to acquire Rally's Hamburgers Inc. in a stock deal valued at about $100 million, the companies said Tuesday.
The combined company will have 949 Rally's and Checkers restaurants, including 73 company-operated and 476 franchised outlets.
Under the terms of the letter of intent, Checkers will offer three of its common shares for each Rally's share. Rally's will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Checkers.
Louisville, Ky.-based Rally's stock edged up 6.25 cents to $3.44, while Checkers rose 15 cents to $1.84 on Nasdaq.
The merger is expected to close in the second or third quarter, subject to a definitive agreement and stockholder approvals.
The companies said the merger would result in increased purchasing and distribution power, favourable marketing and media efficiencies and reduced development costs.

Rally's, along with its franchisees, operate about 471 double drive-thru hamburger restaurants mainly in the Midwest. Clearwater, Fla.-based Checkers, along with its franchisees, operate about 478 double drive-thru hamburger restaurants mainly in the Southeast.
